mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ship_order (order_no, user_id, station_id, courier_company, sender_name, sender_phone, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, goods_type, weight_kg, freight, insured, note, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{stationId}, #{courierCompany}, #{senderName}, #{senderPhone}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{goodsType}, #{weightKg}, #{freight}, #{insured}, #{note}, #{status})
mapper.sql: s.*, u.real_name AS user_name, st.name AS station_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ship_order s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN station st ON st.id = s.station_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

where.if: AND (s.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR s.receiver_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR s.tracking_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ship_order s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN station st ON st.id = s.station_id
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM ship_order s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ship_order SET status = 'DROPPED', dropped_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE ship_order SET status = 'SHIPPED', shipped_at = now(), tracking_no = COALESCE(#{trackingNo}, tracking_no) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DROPPED'
UPDATE ship_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','DROPPED')
